categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in intelligent logistics equipment, focusing on integrated solutions for sorting, warehousing, conveying, and handling. It offers smart sorting systems, smart warehousing systems, baggage sorting solutions, and core components like intelligent vision systems and electric rollers. The business also extends to industrial automation, robotics, software development, and IoT technology services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include industrial IoT high-performance edge computing, autonomous development of key equipment like cross-belt sorters, high-speed wheel sorting, dynamic weighing and scanning systems, AI-based visual detection, OCR recognition, servo motor integrated drive control, wireless power supply, modular distributed electrical control systems, remote fault diagnosis, and integrated warehouse and distribution technologies. Production follows a make-to-order model with in-house design and manufacturing of core components and system integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major express delivery and logistics companies such as ZTO Express, SF Express, JD.com, China Post, and Shopee Express Malaysia. The company serves industries including express logistics, e-commerce, new energy, airports, biomedicine, manufacturing, and smart warehousing. It has a strong presence in domestic Chinese markets and expanding international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province. It has established subsidiaries and sales/service centers across China and internationally in Southeast Asia, the Americas, Europe, Russia, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, the UK, Hungary, Germany, the USA, Brazil, Mexico, and South Korea, supporting a global market footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, providing integrated intelligent logistics equipment and solutions. It develops and manufactures core components and systems, integrating hardware and software to deliver turnkey logistics automation solutions to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically focused on the 'one body, two wings' framework emphasizing intelligent logistics equipment, industrial vision, and power technology. R&D priorities include AI vision systems, dynamic wireless power supply, multi-robot scheduling, high-speed sorting, smart warehousing automation, and airport baggage handling systems. The company invests heavily in innovation, talent acquisition, and expanding its product matrix to maintain technological leadership and support global expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through customized product sales of intelligent logistics equipment and integrated solutions. Additional income streams include service revenues from installation, maintenance, software upgrades, leasing of equipment, and government subsidies. The company also earns investment income from financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic provider of intelligent logistics sorting systems and integrated solutions in China, ranking among the top tier in the express logistics equipment market. It competes with both international giants and local players by leveraging its comprehensive product portfolio, technological innovation, and strong customer relationships with major logistics firms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 2.47 billion, a 26.42% increase year-over-year, though it recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 84.75 million. The company has a total asset base of over RMB 6.19 billion and net assets of approximately RMB 3.54 billion. Despite recent losses, it maintains steady revenue growth and continues investing significantly in R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes technology-driven innovation, high-quality craftsmanship, and comprehensive integrated solutions covering hardware and software. Its products feature high efficiency, precision, automation, and adaptability to diverse logistics scenarios. Proprietary AI vision technologies, wireless power systems, and modular designs provide competitive advantages in cost, performance, and customization, supporting customers' digital transformation and operational efficiency.
